description:
A new road-and-rail bridge is taking shape over the Yangtze River in southwest China's Chongqing.
The Shituo Yangtze River Bridge has completed the closure of both its highway and railway sections. As a key project of the Chongqing-Wanzhou high-speed railway, the bridge is expected to open in 2027.
#Infrastructure #YangtzeRiver #MegaProject #Chongqing #China #Bridge
title: China's new Yangtze River bridge completes closure

description:
A rescued spotted seal was released into the sea off Dalian, China, only to return to the same beach. After his second release farther offshore, "Nana" swam 200km back in six days.
Now locals are asking visitors to admire Nana from a distance: no crowding, no feeding, no disturbing. 
#SpottedSeal #Seal #Wildlife #AnimalTok #Dalian #China
title: Rescued seal swims 200km back to shore in China's Dalian

description:

Developed by #China, #MAZU brings together satellite data, weather observations and #AI. It helps countries around the world strengthen disaster preparedness and protect lives and livelihoods. 🌏
🎥 From Meizhou Island to the world, discover how MAZU is helping turn weather information into earlier action.
